contentItem.title: 圆柱：矩形绕一条边旋转形成
contentItem.englishTitle: When, one side of those about the right angle in a rectangular parallelogram remaining fixed, the parallelogram is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a cylinder.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: When, one side of those about the right angle in a rectangular parallelogram remaining fixed, the parallelogram is carried round and restored again to the same position from which it began to be moved, the figure so comprehended is a cylinder.
当直角方形平行四边形中剩下的一个方形平行四边形被固定时,平行四边形被绕过,并再次恢复到开始移动的同一位置,那么所理解的数字是圆柱形。
